blocks.text: Ingliz tilidagi fe'llarning ko'pi **to'g'ri** (regular): o'tgan zamon shakli va uchinchi shakli `-ed` bilan yasaladi: work → work**ed** → work**ed**. Lekin eng ko'p ishlatiladigan yuzga yaqin fe'l **noto'g'ri** (irregular): ular `-ed` olmaydi, har birining shakllari alohida yod olinadi: go → **went** → **gone**, buy → **bought** → **bought**. O'zbek tilida bunday hodisa yo'q — har bir fe'l bir xil qo'shimcha oladi (bor**di**, ol**di**, ko'r**di**), shuning uchun bu ro'yxatni yodlashga to'g'ri keladi. (→ 24-dars)

rows: Present Simple; to + V1; will / can / must + V1; do / does / did + V1; buyruq gap
have / has / had + V3 — Present Perfect (→ 15-dars); be + V3 — majhul nisbat (→ 21-dars, 116-dars)

items.text: We usually **go** to the mountains in summer.

blocks.text: Ro'yxatni o'qish: ko'p fe'llarda V2 va V3 bir xil (bring → **brought** → **brought**), ba'zilarida uchala shakl bir xil (cut → **cut** → **cut**), qolganlarida uchalasi har xil (write → **wrote** → **written**). Ikki shakl berilgan bo'lsa (**learnt / learned**), ikkalasi ham to'g'ri. Shakli o'xshash fe'llar guruhlab berilgan dars — 118-dars.

Britaniya inglizchasida burn, dream, learn, smell, spell fe'llarining ikkala shakli ishlatiladi: **learnt** va **learned**; amerikanchada asosan `-ed` li shakl. **get** ning V3 shakli Britaniyada **got** (I've **got** a cold), Amerikada ko'pincha **gotten**. **read** ning uchala shakli bir xil yoziladi, lekin V2 va V3 boshqacha talaffuz qilinadi.

**go** ning V3 shakli — **gone**, lekin Present Perfect da ko'pincha **been** ham ishlatiladi va ma'nosi farq qiladi. **has gone** to — «ketgan, hozir o'sha yerda». **has been** to — «borib kelgan, endi qaytgan». Shuning uchun «Have you ever **been** to Samarkand?» (Samarqandda bo'lganmisiz?) deyiladi. (→ 17-dars)

items.text: I **lay** in bed and read a book.
She **laid** the baby on the bed.
He **lied** to his parents about the exam.
My son **fell** off the chair, but he soon **felt** fine.
items.translation: O'g'lim stuldan **yiqildi**, lekin tez orada o'zini yaxshi **his qildi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have went.» → I have **gone** (have dan keyin V3); «I didn't went.» → I didn't **go** (did o'zi o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatadi, undan keyin V1); «Did you saw it?» → Did you **see** it?; «Yesterday I buyed a phone.» → I **bought**; «The window was broke.» → was **broken** (majhulda V3); «She has wrote.» → has **written**.

Yodlash usuli: har kuni 5–7 ta fe'lni uchta shakli bilan ovoz chiqarib ayting (go – went – gone), keyin har biriga o'zingiz haqingizda ikkita gap tuzing: biri V2 bilan (Yesterday I **went** ...), biri V3 bilan (I've never **been** ...). Avval V2 = V3 bo'lgan fe'llarni o'rganing — ular eng oson. Shakli o'xshash guruhlar — 118-darsda.

items: **V1** — Present Simple, infinitiv, do / does / did dan keyin, will / can / must dan keyin.
**V2** — faqat Past Simple darak gapida: I **went**, she **saw**.
**V3** — have / has / had dan keyin (Present Perfect, Past Perfect) va be dan keyin (majhul nisbat).
Ko'p noto'g'ri fe'llarda V2 = V3 (made, told, bought); ba'zilarida uchala shakl bir xil (cut, put, let); qolganlarida uchalasi har xil (wrote, written).

examples.title: Verbs A–B: **became**, **began**, **brought**
examples.description: A–B harflaridagi fe'llarning V2 shakli (Past Simple) va V3 shakli (have + V3, be + V3) gaplarda.

sentences.text: My cousin **became** a doctor after seven years of study.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham yetti yillik o'qishdan keyin shifokor **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: The concert **began** an hour late because of the rain.
sentences.translation: Konsert yomg'ir tufayli bir soat kech **boshlandi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **brought** a big bag of apples from her village.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza qishlog'idan bir katta xalta olma **olib keldi**.

sentences.text: Have you ever **been** to Manchester?
sentences.translation: Hech Manchesterda **bo'lganmisiz**?

sentences.text: Our team **was beaten** 3–0 in the final.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz finalda 3:0 hisobida **mag'lub bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: A dog **bit** my little brother in the park last week.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta parkda it ukamni **tishlab oldi**.

sentences.text: Somebody **has broken** the mirror in the bathroom.
sentences.translation: Kimdir hammomdagi oynani **sindiribdi**.

sentences.text: The wind **blew** so hard that our tent flew away.
sentences.translation: Shamol shunchalik qattiq **esdiki**, chodirimiz uchib ketdi.

sentences.text: These houses **were built** by my grandfather's company.
sentences.translation: Bu uylar bobomning kompaniyasi tomonidan **qurilgan**.

sentences.text: I **burnt** my finger while I was cooking, so I **bought** some cream at the chemist's.
sentences.translation: Ovqat pishirayotib barmog'imni **kuydirib oldim**, shuning uchun dorixonadan krem **sotib oldim**.

examples.title: Verbs C–D: **caught**, **chose**, **drew**, **drove**
examples.description: C–D harflaridagi fe'llar: catch, choose, cost, cut, come, dig, do, draw, dream, drink, drive — V2 va V3 shakllari.

sentences.text: Sarah **caught** the last train to Oxford just in time.
sentences.translation: Sara Oksfordga ketadigan oxirgi poyezdga zo'rg'a **ulgurdi**.

sentences.text: Madina **chose** the blue dress, not the red one.
sentences.translation: Madina qizil emas, ko'k ko'ylakni **tanladi**.

sentences.text: Our trip to Khiva **cost** less than we expected.
sentences.translation: Xivaga sayohatimiz kutganimizdan arzonroqqa **tushdi**.

sentences.text: Grandma **cut** the bread into thick slices.
sentences.translation: Buvim nonni qalin qilib **to'g'radi**.

sentences.text: Our guests **came** from Namangan late at night.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarimiz Namangandan kechasi **kelishdi**.

sentences.text: The workers **dug** a deep hole for the new pipe.
sentences.translation: Ishchilar yangi quvur uchun chuqur o'ra **qazishdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has** already **done** the shopping for the party.
sentences.translation: Sara ziyofat uchun xaridni allaqachon **qilib bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: My son **drew** a picture of our cat and gave it to me.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim mushugimizning rasmini **chizdi** va menga sovg'a qildi.

sentences.text: Last night I **dreamt** that I was flying over Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Kecha **tush ko'rdim**: Samarqand ustidan uchib yurgan ekanman.

sentences.text: Bekzod **drank** a cup of strong coffee and **drove** to work.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bir piyola achchiq qahva **ichdi** va mashinada ishga **jo'nadi**.

examples.title: Verbs E–F: **ate**, **fell**, **found**, **forgot**
examples.description: E–F harflaridagi fe'llar: eat, fall, feed, feel, find, fly, forget, freeze — V2 va V3 shakllari.

sentences.text: We **ate** far too much plov at the wedding.
sentences.translation: To'yda juda ko'p palov **yeb qo'ydik**.

sentences.text: Have you **eaten** anything since breakfast?
sentences.translation: Nonushtadan beri biror narsa **yedingizmi**?

sentences.text: Aziz **fell** off his bike and hurt his knee.
sentences.translation: Aziz velosipeddan **yiqilib tushdi** va tizzasini lat yedirdi.

sentences.text: Lots of leaves **have fallen** in the garden overnight.
sentences.translation: Bir kechada bog'ga ko'p barg **to'kilibdi**.

sentences.text: Who **fed** the cat this morning?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab mushukni kim **ovqatlantirdi**?

sentences.text: I **felt** much better after a long sleep.
sentences.translation: Uzoq uxlagandan keyin o'zimni ancha yaxshi **his qildim**.

sentences.text: Emma **found** her keys under the sofa.
sentences.translation: Emma kalitlarini divan ostidan **topdi**.

sentences.text: My parents **flew** to Istanbul for their holiday.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam ta'tilga Istanbulga **uchib ketishdi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I completely **forgot** about your birthday!
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, tug'ilgan kuningizni butunlay **unutib qo'yibman**!

sentences.text: The lake **froze** last winter, and the children skated on it every day.
sentences.translation: O'tgan qish ko'l **muzlab qoldi**, bolalar har kuni uning ustida konkida uchishdi.

examples.title: Verbs G–H: **got**, **gave**, **gone**, **heard**
examples.description: G–H harflaridagi fe'llar: get, give, go, grow, hang, have, hear, hide, hit, hold — V2 va V3 shakllari.

sentences.text: Tom **got** a new job in Manchester last month.
sentences.translation: Tom o'tgan oy Manchesterda yangi ish **topdi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **gave** me this ring on my wedding day.
sentences.translation: Bu uzukni menga buvim to'yim kuni **bergan**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has gone** to the bank — he'll be back soon.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bankka **ketdi** — tez orada qaytadi.

sentences.text: Our tomatoes **grew** really well this summer.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz pomidorlarimiz juda yaxshi **o'sdi**.

sentences.text: Where **have** you **hung** my jacket?
sentences.translation: Kurtkamni qayerga **ilib qo'ydingiz**?

sentences.text: We **had** a wonderful time in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda ajoyib vaqt **o'tkazdik**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **heard** the news about Sarah?
sentences.translation: Sara haqidagi yangilikni **eshitdingizmi**?

sentences.text: The children **hid** behind the door and waited for their father.
sentences.translation: Bolalar eshik orqasiga **berkinib**, otalarini kutishdi.

sentences.text: A ball **hit** the window, but luckily it didn't break.
sentences.translation: To'p derazaga **tegdi**, lekin xayriyat, sinmadi.

sentences.text: The meeting **was held** in the main hall because so many people came.
sentences.translation: Odam ko'p kelgani uchun yig'ilish katta zalda **o'tkazildi**.

examples.title: Verbs K–L: **kept**, **knew**, **left**, **lost**
examples.description: K–L harflaridagi fe'llar: keep, know, lay, lead, learn, leave, lend, lie, lose — V2 va V3 shakllari.

sentences.text: Madina **kept** all her school notebooks for years.
sentences.translation: Madina barcha maktab daftarlarini yillar davomida **saqlab keldi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **knew** the answer, not even the teacher.
sentences.translation: Javobni hech kim **bilmasdi**, hatto o'qituvchi ham.

sentences.text: I've **known** James since we were at school together.
sentences.translation: Jeymsni maktabda birga o'qiganimizdan beri **taniyman**.

sentences.text: The waiter **laid** the table for six people.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant stolni olti kishiga **tuzadi**.

sentences.text: Our guide **led** us through the narrow streets of the old city.
sentences.translation: Gidimiz bizni eski shaharning tor ko'chalari bo'ylab **boshlab bordi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **learnt** English at a language school in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ingliz tilini Toshkentdagi til maktabida **o'rgangan**.

sentences.text: The train **had** already **left** when we got to the station.
sentences.translation: Biz vokzalga yetib borganimizda poyezd allaqachon **jo'nab ketgan edi**.

sentences.text: Can you give back the money I **lent** you last month?
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy senga **qarzga bergan** pulimni qaytarib bera olasanmi?

sentences.text: After lunch, Grandpa **lay** on the sofa and fell asleep.
sentences.translation: Tushlikdan keyin bobom divanga **yotdi** va uxlab qoldi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I've **lost** your umbrella — I **left** it on the bus.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, soyaboningizni **yo'qotib qo'ydim** — avtobusda **qoldirib ketibman**.

examples.title: Verbs M–R: **made**, **met**, **paid**, **read**
examples.description: M–R harflaridagi fe'llar: make, meet, pay, put, quit, read, ride, ring, rise, run — V2 va V3 shakllari.

sentences.text: Emma **made** a delicious cake for her mother's birthday.
sentences.translation: Emma onasining tug'ilgan kuniga mazali tort **pishirdi**.

sentences.text: Tom **ran** all the way to the station, but he missed the train.
sentences.translation: Tom vokzalgacha **yugurib bordi**, lekin poyezdga ulgurmadi.

sentences.text: Aziz and Sarah **met** at university in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Aziz va Sara Oksforddagi universitetda **tanishgan**.

sentences.text: Who **paid** for the taxi last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun taksiga kim **to'ladi**?

sentences.text: My brother **put** his phone on the table and forgot about it.
sentences.translation: Akam telefonini stolga **qo'ydi**-yu, uni unutib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Last year Bekzod **quit** his job and started his own business.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Bekzod ishini **tashladi** va o'z biznesini boshladi.

sentences.text: I **have read** this book three times, and I still love it.
sentences.translation: Bu kitobni uch marta **o'qiganman** va hali ham yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: On holiday in the mountains, we **rode** horses for the first time.
sentences.translation: Tog'dagi ta'tilda birinchi marta ot **mindik**.

sentences.text: The phone **rang** three times, but nobody answered.
sentences.translation: Telefon uch marta **jiringladi**, lekin hech kim javob bermadi.

sentences.text: Prices **have risen** a lot this year, so we spend more on food.
sentences.translation: Bu yil narxlar ancha **oshdi**, shuning uchun ovqatga ko'proq sarflayapmiz.

examples.title: Verbs S: **said**, **seen**, **sold**, **spoke**
examples.description: S harfidagi fe'llar: say, see, sell, send, shake, sleep, speak, spend, stand, swim — V2 va V3 shakllari.

sentences.text: Madina **said** goodbye and closed the door quietly.
sentences.translation: Madina **xayr dedi** va eshikni sekin yopdi.

sentences.text: The kids **swam** in the river all afternoon.
sentences.translation: Bolalar tushdan keyin bo'yi daryoda **cho'milishdi**.

sentences.text: Have you ever **seen** snow in Tashkent in April?
sentences.translation: Hech aprelda Toshkentda qor **ko'rganmisiz**?

sentences.text: My uncle **sold** his old car and bought a bicycle.
sentences.translation: Amakim eski mashinasini **sotdi** va velosiped sotib oldi.

sentences.text: The company **has sent** me an email about the job.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya menga ish haqida xat **jo'natdi**.

sentences.text: We **stood** in the queue for an hour to buy tickets.
sentences.translation: Chipta olish uchun bir soat navbatda **turdik**.

sentences.text: Everyone **shook** hands at the end of the meeting.
sentences.translation: Uchrashuv oxirida hamma qo'l **siqishdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **slept** for twelve hours after the long journey.
sentences.translation: Uzoq safardan keyin Bekzod o'n ikki soat **uxladi**.

sentences.text: Our teacher **spoke** so quickly that we didn't understand anything.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz shunchalik tez **gapirdiki**, biz hech narsa tushunmadik.

sentences.text: Last summer we **spent** two weeks by the sea.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yoz ikki haftani dengiz bo'yida **o'tkazdik**.

examples.title: Verbs T–W: **took**, **told**, **thought**, **won**
examples.description: T–W harflaridagi fe'llar: take, teach, tell, think, throw, understand, wake, wear, win, write — V2 va V3 shakllari.

sentences.text: Who **took** my pen? It was here a minute ago.
sentences.translation: Ruchkamni kim **oldi**? Bir daqiqa oldin shu yerda edi.

sentences.text: Mr Brown **taught** us maths for five years.
sentences.translation: Janob Braun bizga besh yil matematikadan **dars bergan**.

sentences.text: Aziz **told** me a funny story about his first day at work.
sentences.translation: Aziz menga ishdagi birinchi kuni haqida kulgili voqeani **aytib berdi**.

sentences.text: I **thought** the shop was open, but it was closed.
sentences.translation: Do'kon ochiq deb **o'ylabman**, lekin yopiq ekan.

sentences.text: Somebody **threw** a stone at our window.
sentences.translation: Kimdir derazamizga tosh **otdi**.

sentences.text: Nobody **understood** the question, so the teacher explained it again.
sentences.translation: Savolni hech kim **tushunmadi**, shuning uchun o'qituvchi uni yana tushuntirdi.

sentences.text: The baby **woke** up three times last night.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq kecha kechasi uch marta **uyg'ondi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wore** a beautiful atlas dress at her sister's wedding.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza opasining to'yida chiroyli atlas ko'ylak **kiydi**.

sentences.text: Our school team **has won** the city football cup!
sentences.translation: Maktab jamoamiz shahar futbol kubogini **yutib oldi**!

sentences.text: This book **was written** by a teacher from Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Bu kitob samarqandlik o'qituvchi tomonidan **yozilgan**.
